entries.topic: Sources for the presidential and theology tests (Nov 2026)

claims.text: Bruenn diagnosed acute congestive heart failure on 28 March 1944; Lahey wrote on 10 July 1944 that Roosevelt would again have heart failure and be unable to complete another term; the memo was suppressed and published decades later.

Dewey declared for a free and democratic Jewish Commonwealth on 15 Oct 1944 after meeting Silver; on 7 Oct 1946 called for immigration of several hundreds of thousands; the 26 Jun 1944 Republican platform condemned the President's failure to insist on the Balfour Declaration and the Mandate.

sources.label: History.com: FDR was gravely ill in his final term (Bruenn, March 1944; Lahey memo, 10 July 1944)
JTA, 15 Oct 1944: Dewey supports establishment of Jewish Commonwealth on basis of Balfour Declaration
JTA, 7 Oct 1946: Dewey backs Truman demand for Palestine immigration
Jewish Virtual Library: Republican platform calls for implementation of Balfour Declaration (26 Jun 1944)
